definitions.gloss: to get used to, to become accustomed to
definitions.explanation: To become familiar with something through repeated exposure or practice. The thing one gets used to takes the particle に.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{仕事|しごと}に{慣|な}れました。
examples.english: I got used to the new job.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{生活|せいかつ}に{慣|な}れましたか。
examples.english: Have you gotten used to life in Japan?

examples.japanese: まだ{慣|な}れていません。
examples.english: I'm not used to it yet.

notes: An ichidan verb. The thing you get used to is marked with に. Often used with まだ (not yet) or もう (already) to indicate progress in becoming accustomed. Different from {習|なら}う (to learn) which has a similar reading.
